messages:
miko: FYI bringing sakura-lite-q3 (int8) into staging for onboarding checks. seeing reproducible BLEU drop on zh-Hant->en (~-3.8) and some malformed ruby/bracket rendering for ja inputs. tagging @rahul @kai
rahul: thanks. minimal repro and the eval command?
miko: repro example: "《源氏》の注釈：〈るい〉は…". eval: `./run_eval --model sakura-lite-q3 --quant int8 --locales zh_Hant,ja_JP --samples 1500 --seed 7`
kai: is this present in fp16 or only int8 artifacts?
miko: fp16 baseline fine; int8 shows bracket tokens shifted and angle brackets inserted around ruby. also token ids differ: encode(...) -> [210, 4020, 88, 9100] (trimmed).
sarah: could be merge-table rebuild during quant serialization. we had hash-seed drift once that split U+3008/U+3009 differently. can you dump merge map?
rahul: starting bisect across quant build commits (b1c3..e5d9). also run `tools/inspect_merges --artifact sakura-lite-q3-int8` and attach output.
miko: attached gist: https://ci.redwood/g/8291 and quick eval: fp16 zh_Hant BLEU=26.9, int8=23.1. ja unaffected.
rahul: reproduced locally. commit c2e7 rebuilt merge table with new seed; that causes the bracket pair to be tokenized as two subtokens in int8. reproduction: `python -c "from tokenizer import T; print(T('sakura-lite-q3',commit='c2e7').encode('〈るい〉'))"`
kai: shortcut: try disabling prefix compaction in tokenizer as smoke: `--no-prefix-merge`.
sarah: did a local regen of quant merge table using original seed and reserialized artifact -> detok parity restored on 250-sample check. opened PR `pr/314-lock-merge-seed`.
rahul: plan: 1) confirm mapping diff 2) rebuild int8 artifact with locked seed 3) run full 2k eval across locales 4) if regressions persist, roll back quant build change on staging.
eval-bot: nightly run created: https://ci.redwood/runs/21021  preliminary: fp16 zh_Hant BLEU=26.9, int8-rebuilt BLEU=26.8 (candidate).
miko: filing RED-ML-5033 to track and adding build-check to onboarding checklist: ensure tokenizer seed pinned during quantized table generation.
\ai: note: add unit test asserting U+3000..U+303F bracket preservation across quant configs. rahul: adding `tests/tokenizer/test_bracket_atomization.py`.
rahul: i'll run full eval tomorrow and update thread. thanks team.
